_comment: Declared audiences for the BDD taxonomy (bdd-comprehensive-testing). Every scenario's @audience must be one of these. TrackPoli admin auth is seen by an Administrator, an Administrator Manager, and the anonymous/attacker caller who has no session. The design-system effort (ADR-0011) adds four more: a developer coding a feature with the system, a maintainer relying on CI to enforce it, an assistive-tech user of the rendered components, and an end-user seeing the migrated screens. Added in PR 0 so the design-system scenarios authored in later PRs pass check-bdd-tags.
